Sprites

Choose from 12 base sprites and their Gem, Gold, and Gamer variants. Equip an extracted sprite before a match. Carry sprites to the end and win to extract them, earn their match XP, and collect Sprite Dust. A sprite you bring into a match is lost if you fail to extract it; spend Dust to recover it. New sprites found during a match are temporary until extracted. XP: +25 per elimination, +10 per chest, +100 per win. Level costs: 75, 150, 500, 1,000, and 2,000 XP. Sprite powers are passive or level-based; Earth grants 50 shield and a random weapon upgrade when it gains a level.

Settings Customize your Stormfall experience

Changes are saved automatically in this browser. Graphics changes apply immediately; gameplay options take effect in your next match where noted.

Graphics

Optimize for my PC switches to the Potato preset, turns off shadows and glow, and lowers the render scale: the fastest the game can run. Auto adjusts quality based on performance. Render scale trades image sharpness for frame rate. Higher presets use more GPU and memory.

Aim & Camera

Aim assist slows your look near opponents; High also adds bullet magnetism. Aim assist is disabled while building, driving, or using a scope.

Audio

Music: “Island Meet and Greet”, “Pamgaea”, “Tiki Bar Mixer”, and “Danger Storm” by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0.

Gameplay

Turbo Build repeatedly attempts to place the selected build while you hold the build button; turn it off to place once per press and allow Open edit after building to open immediately. In edit mode, select wall or floor tiles to cut them, select a roof edge to reshape a cone into a slope, or select a stair row/side to turn the ramp. Use Reset to restore the original piece or your mapped edit/build control to confirm. Auto confirm edits can confirm when you release a selection. Edit tooltip hides all edit HUD prompts and controls. Bot difficulty and time of day are chosen when a match starts. Voice chat uses your browser’s speech features when supported.

Controls

Select any of the three bind boxes, then press a key, click a mouse button, or scroll the wheel. Use × to clear a slot; Escape cancels rebinding. A key can be assigned to more than one action. Bindings are saved in this browser. In the map editor, place with left click, look with right click, and pan with middle click or the Hand tool.

Left stick
Move. Push it all the way forward to sprint
Drag right side
Look around and aim
FIRE · AIM
Hold FIRE to shoot or swing · AIM toggles aiming down sights (in build mode it swaps material)
JUMP · CROUCH
Jump, dive from the plane, open the glider, handbrake in cars · CROUCH toggles crouching
USE
Glows when you can open a chest, pick something up, open a door or get in a car
RELOAD · BUILD
Reload your gun · switch to build mode, then tap WALL, FLOOR, RAMP or ROOF and FIRE to place; aim up to place a floor above you or down to place it at your feet
Hotbar
Tap a slot to switch weapons or items
Top buttons
ITEMS inventory · DROP selected item · SHOP · EMOTE · CAM camera view · MAP · II pause
Driving
The stick steers and drives · USE gets out

Move · Shift sprint · Ctrl crouch · Space jump · Ctrl while sprinting to slide
Mouse
Left fire / swing sword · Right aim down sights · Wheel cycles slots · Middle click pings · all remappable in Settings → Controls
1–6 · F
Inventory slots · Tide Blade (sword)
E · R
Interact (chests, pickups, doors, cars, vending machines) · reload (every reload takes 2 s or less)

Enter
